monument_name: Jāhārkoṭa Devaldhārā (built between the 2nd half of the 14th cent. and the 15th cent.)
description_en: Aśikharatemple on top of a fountain from circa 14th-15th century.The monument is situated in the locality of Jāhārkoṭa, also known as Jārkoṭa, 3 km north of Narayan, the district headquarters.Theśikharatemple is oriented to the west. Its door is preceeded by a pillared porch (ardhamaṇḍapa), an arrangement similar to that of the central temple of the nearby site of Pañcadevala (DLK0070). The decoration on the two pillars, with an upward triangular motif, is also noted in Pañcadevala and at the base of numerous stone memorial pillars of the Karnali region. Thesanctumis currently empty, only traces of paving remain.In front of theśikhara, to the west, is a fountain with a stone facing. Fountains are locally known asmugrāhā. The facing is carved with various mouldings andāmalakafriezes. Water used to come out through two spouts carved with makara heads. Rectangular platforms are placed at the northern and southern ends of the fountain. D. R. Sharma has suggested that the purpose of the fountain was to provide fresh water for the worship of the temple's deity (Sharma 2012: p. 120).The association of aśikharatemple with a fountain is unique in the Dailekh district. It is more commonly found in the Jumla and Mugu districts (see for instanceMUG0040). The Jāhārkoṭa monuments, as well as the otherdevaldharasin the Karnali may be dated between the second half of the 14th century and the 15th century (Andolfatto 2019: 88-89, p. 101-102).The monument is mentioned inSharma 2012: p. 118-120 andAndolfatto 2019: p. 85-86.
description_ne: दैलेखको जाहारकोटमा अवस्थित ढुंगेधारा माथिको यो शिखर शैलीको देवल १४औं-१५औं शताव्दीमा बनाइएको देखिन्छ ।यस पश्चिमाभिमुख देवल दैलेखको जिल्ला सदरमुकाम नारायणबाट ३ किलोमीटर उत्तरतिर पर्छ । देवलको मूलद्वारमा ढुंगाका दुई खम्बाले थामेको दैलो राखिएको छ । यो स्वरूप नजिकै रहेको पञ्चदेवल (DLK0070) को पाँचमध्ये केन्द्रको देवलसंग मेल खान्छ । दुई खम्बामा रहेको माथि फर्किएको त्रिकोणात्मक बुट्टा पञ्चदेवल लगायत कर्णाली भेगका अरू थुप्रै स्तम्भ वा खम्बाहरूमा पनि देखिन्छ । देवलको गर्भगृह खाली रहेको छ भने त्यहाँ बिछ्याइएका ढुंगा पनि जीर्ण भैसकेको छ ।यस देवलको अगाडी (पश्चिमपट्टि) ढुंगेधारा रहेको छ । स्थानीय भाषामा ढुंगेधारालाई मुग्राहा भनिन्छ । ढुंगेधाराको टुप्पोमा विभिन्न बुट्टा कुँदिएका छन् । ढुंगेधाराका मकर आकृतिका दुई टुटीहरूबाट पहिले पानी झर्ने गर्दथ्यो । देवलको मूर्ति पुजाका लागि यस ढुंगेधारा बनाइएको हुनुपर्दछ (Sharma 2012: p. 120) ।ढुंगेधारासंग सम्बन्धित शिखर शैलीको मन्दिर दैलेख जिल्लामा अन्त पाइदैन । जुम्ला र मुगु जिल्लामा भने यस्ता उदाहरणहरू धेरै देखिन्छ (हेर्नुहोस्MUG0040) । जाहारकोटको देवलधारा लगायत कर्णालीका अरु देवलधाराहरू १४औं शताव्दीको अन्तदेखि १५औं शताव्दीभित्र बनाइएको हुनसक्छ (Andolfatto 2019: p. 88-89, p. 101-102) ।Sharma 2012: p. 118-120 रAndolfatto 2019: p. 85-86 ले पनि यस देवलधाराका बारेमा उल्लेख गरेका छन् ।
references: REFERENCES Andolfatto, David C. 2019. Le Pays aux Cent-Vingt-Cinq-Mille Montagnes. Etude Archéologique du Bassin de la Karnali (Népal) entre le XIIe et le XVIe siècle . Paris: Sorbonne Université. Sharma, Dilli Raj. 2012. Heritage of Western Nepal. Art and Architecture . Kathmandu: Centre for Nepal and Asian Studies.
